skills.name: LCD Conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and rewrite fractions with unlike denominators as equivalent fractions with that common denominator.

skills.name: Numerator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator to obtain the fraction-part result.

skills.name: Simplify Fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Whole-Part Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts of two operands, treating a bare whole number as having an implicit zero-numerator fraction part.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: When subtracting the fraction parts yields a negative value, regroup one whole unit as denominator/denominator, decrease the whole part by one, and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize Improper Mixed Number
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard form by moving the extra whole unit(s) into the whole-number part before subtracting.

skills.name: Same-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator to get the fraction-part result.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When subtracting fraction parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (as denominator/denominator) from the whole-number part and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction result (or convert to whole/mixed form) to its simplest equivalent form.

skills.name: Mixed-number decomposition & recombination
skills.definition: Separate a mixed or whole number into whole and fractional parts, subtract the whole-number parts, and recombine the whole and fraction results into the final answer.

skills.name: Improper fraction-part normalization
skills.definition: Recognize when a mixed number's fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) and convert it into a proper mixed number by carrying the excess into the whole part before subtracting.

skills.name: Common-denominator componentwise subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators (and whole parts, if present) once both quantities share the same denominator.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions into equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Borrowing across whole/fraction
skills.definition: When the fraction subtraction produces a negative value, borrow one whole unit (as denominator/denominator) and recompute the fraction and whole parts.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Operand reformatting
skills.definition: Rewrite a bare whole number as 'whole + 0/d' or a pure fraction as '0 + fraction/d' so it matches the whole-plus-fraction structure needed for subtraction.

skills.name: Improper mixed-number normalization
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form before subtracting.

skills.name: Find LCD & convert fractions
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator for two fractions with unlike denominators and convert both to equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract numerators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that share a common denominator to obtain the fractional difference.

skills.name: Whole-part subtraction & combination
skills.definition: Separate the whole-number part(s) of mixed numbers/whole numbers, subtract them, and combine the result with the fractional difference to form the final mixed-number or integer answer.

skills.name: Borrow/regroup
skills.definition: When the fraction subtraction yields a negative result, borrow one unit (d/d) from the whole part and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Normalize improper fractional part
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into an equivalent proper mixed number before performing subtraction.

skills.name: Same-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators directly for two pure fractions (no whole-number part) that already share a common denominator, keeping that denominator.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Whole/fraction part separation and subtraction
skills.definition: Split a mixed number (or a whole number/pure fraction treated as a mixed number with a 0 part) into whole and fractional components and subtract each part independently when no regrouping is needed.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When subtracting the fractional parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (expressed as denominator/denominator) from the whole part and redo the fractional subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction to its lowest-terms equivalent by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Normalize improper fractional part
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard form by carrying the excess whole units into the whole-number part before subtracting.
